parameters.query: INSERT INTO proposals (proposal_id, deal_id, client_id, contact_email, company_name, title, line_items, subtotal, discount, tax_amount, total, currency, payment_terms, valid_until, status, created_by) VALUES ('{{ $json.proposal_id }}', {{ $json.deal_id || 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.contact_email }}', '{{ $json.company_name }}', '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.line_items) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.subtotal }}, {{ $json.discount }}, {{ $json.tax_amount }}, {{ $json.total }}, '{{ $json.currency }}', '{{ $json.payment_terms }}', '{{ $json.valid_until }}', 'sent', '{{ $json.created_by }}') RETURNING *

UPDATE deals SET stage = 'proposal', probability = 40, deal_value = {{ $json.total }}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.deal_id || 0 }} AND stage IN ('prospecting', 'qualification'); INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) SELECT d.contact_id, 'proposal_sent', '{"proposal_id": "{{ $json.proposal_id }}", "value": {{ $json.total }}}'::jsonb, 10 FROM deals d WHERE d.id = {{ $json.deal_id || 0 }};

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, proposal_id: $json.proposal_id, total: $json.total, valid_until: $json.valid_until }) }}
